LLM auditresponse for .gitignore:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This is a standard .gitignore file for an Arch User Repository package. It uses a default-ignore-all pattern (`*`) followed by explicit unignore rules for files normally tracked in AUR repositories: PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, patches, shell scripts, systemd units, config files, documentation, licenses, and source files. It also ignores common build artifacts such as `pkg/`, `src/`, `*.pkg.tar*`, `*.o`, `*.so`, and editor temporary files. No network requests, code execution, obfuscation, data exfiltration, or system modification is present. This is ordinary packaging hygiene and shows no signs of a supply-chain attack.
</details>
